title: yasserstudio/gmc · embedded MCP
summary: Insert or delete product inputs, query reports, inspect issues, and validate local feed files before upload.
method: SDK tools/list on in-memory transports, preserving registration code and replacing only application imports/configuration; independently re-extracted.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Diagnose auth, GCP-project registration, and Merchant API access. Run this first to verify your setup works.
tools.summary: Diagnose auth, GCP-project registration, and Merchant API access.
notes: Resolves auth, mints token, and probes Merchant API; diagnoses configuration but does not register project or configure account.

tools.name: accounts_list
tools.description: List Merchant Center accounts accessible by the current credential.
tools.summary: List Merchant Center accounts accessible by the current credential.

tools.name: accounts_get
tools.description: Get details for a specific Merchant Center account.
tools.summary: Get details for a specific Merchant Center account.

tools.name: products_list
tools.description: List products in a Merchant Center account. Returns processed products with status and item-level issues.
tools.summary: List products in a Merchant Center account.
notes: page_size defaults to 50 in handler (not a JSON Schema default); service follows all pages, so it is not a total result limit.

tools.name: products_get

tools.name: products_insert
tools.description: Insert or update a product in a Merchant Center account.

data_source.description: Data source id to insert into

tools.summary: Insert or update a product in a Merchant Center account.
notes: Direct POST productInputs:insert creates/replaces a product input; no preview or commit gate. product is an unrestricted JSON object, not a nested ProductInput schema.

tools.name: products_delete
tools.description: Delete a product from a Merchant Center account.

data_source.description: Data source id the product belongs to

tools.summary: Delete a product from a Merchant Center account.
notes: Direct DELETE productInputs; no preview or commit gate.

tools.name: datasources_list
tools.description: List data sources (feeds) for a Merchant Center account.
tools.summary: List data sources (feeds) for a Merchant Center account.

tools.name: issues_account
tools.description: Get account-level issues (disapprovals, warnings) for a Merchant Center account.
tools.summary: Get account-level issues (disapprovals, warnings) for a Merchant Center account.

tools.name: quota_list
tools.description: List daily Merchant API call quota and current usage.
tools.summary: List daily Merchant API call quota and current usage.

tools.name: reports_query
tools.description: Run an MCQL query against the Merchant Center reports API. Use product_performance_view for clicks/impressions.

query.description: MCQL query string, e.g. 'SELECT offer_id, clicks FROM product_performance_view WHERE date BETWEEN "2026-01-01" AND "2026-01-31"'

tools.summary: Run an MCQL query against the Merchant Center reports API.
notes: Generic MCQL read query passed to reports:search POST; follows pagination.

tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Validate product feed files offline against Merchant Center rules — catches disapprovals before upload. No API call, no auth needed.

dir.description: Directory of product JSON files to scan (default: 'feeds')

tools.summary: Validate product feed files offline against Merchant Center rules — catches disapprovals before upload.
notes: Offline local JSON file read/validation. dir defaults to feeds in handler; strict inherits preflight config unless supplied. No schema defaults.
Start the embedded server with gmc mcp. Account defaults can come from CLI profiles; explicit account parameters remain available.
products_insert and products_delete perform immediate mutations; these tools have no preview or confirmation parameter.
